subject: Tactical rate match and ops carveouts for BlueGate migration
messages:
From: Matthew Liu <matthew.liu@bluegate.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: BlueGate Legal <legal@bluegate.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: BlueGate: Clarification on transition credits & onboarding risks

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the demo last week. We’re close to a decision but our procurement team has put a couple of specific asks on the table before we can sign:

- Match the competitor’s upfront migration credit of $225k applied as a 3-month bill credit.
- Provide a 12-month egress credit bucket for model exports or provide a lower egress rate for the first year.
- Commit to dedicated onboarding hours (SRE support) in the first 60 days or an offset credit if we need to self-service.
- Include a 90-day rollback window (partial refund of credits) if key latency SLAs aren't met in production.

Can Redwood accommodate those as structured concessions? The RFP is attached for context (BlueGate_RFP.pdf).

Our target go-live is Sept 1; procurement needs the commercial terms nailed down by end of June for internal approvals.

Best,

Matthew Liu
Head of Cloud Platform
BlueGate Systems
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Matthew Liu <matthew.liu@bluegate.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Jun 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BlueGate: Clarification on transition credits & onboarding risks

Matthew —

Appreciate the clarity and the RFP. High-level response and three pragmatic options below so procurement can pick a path that aligns with their risk appetite.

On Mon, Jun 9, 2025 at 9:12 AM Matthew Liu <matthew.liu@bluegate.com> wrote:
> Thanks for the demo last week. We’re close to a decision but our procurement team has put a couple of specific asks on the table before we can sign:...

Proposed options (we can convert any of these into formal language / DocuSign):

Option A — Match + Conditional Onboard (Preferred)
- Upfront migration credit: $225,000 applied as a three-month service credit.
- Egress: 50% discount on egress charges for 12 months (capped at $50k).
- Onboarding: 40 SRE hours reserved and scheduled within the first 60 days. Additional SRE time billed at a discounted rate.
- SLA carveout: 90-day rollback clause that escalates to a pro-rated credit if p50 latency targets are missed for two consecutive weekly windows.

Option B — Lower upfront + higher operational support
- Upfront credit: $150,000 over 3 months.
- Egress: flat reduced rate for 12 months (no cap).
- Onboarding: 80 hours SRE + two optional on-site days during cutover.
- No rollback; instead, guarantee remediation timeline with priority triage.

Option C — Credits replaced with extended term discount
- No upfront credit; 15% discount on committed consumption for 12 months.
- 30 reserved SRE hours.

Notes / legal: we will accept a limited rollback clause but need to define clear SLA metrics and a narrow trigger window. Connor and Marissa are looped to confirm the operational feasibility and to produce proposed contract language.

I attached a short commercial summary (kimberly_proposal_summary.pdf) and a redline of standard terms for legal review. Please let me know which option procurement prefers by Friday so we can lock in resource scheduling.

Thanks,

Kimberly Park
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai | +1 415 555 0178
From: Matthew Liu <matthew.liu@bluegate.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: BlueGate Legal <legal@bluegate.com>, procurement@bluegate.com
Date: Tue, 10 Jun 2025 09:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BlueGate: Clarification on transition credits & onboarding risks

Kimberly —

Thanks for the three options. Procurement is leaning to Option A but legal has two asks before we can proceed to signature:

1) Rollback mechanism must include an objective performance measurement (p50 latency for 95th percentile of traffic during a 7-day window) and a cap on total refund exposure (we'd accept up to 50% of the migration credit as a maximum refund).
2) Indemnity/liability carveouts around third-party model behaviors; they want clarity that runtime regressions caused by model architecture incompatibilities are handled via support SLAs rather than a commercial refund in the first 180 days.

We’ll need a DocuSign-ready version to circulate with our CFO and legal. Target internal approval by June 20. I’ve pasted the DocuSign link they prefer: https://www.docusign.com/link/abcdef

Also note: our implementation team flagged a hard go-live constraint — feature freeze on Aug 15 to allow integration testing, so we need a short onboarding calendar that front-loads the reserved SRE hours in July.

Matt

Matthew Liu
Head of Cloud Platform
BlueGate Systems
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Jun 2025 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: BlueGate concessions — recommended approach

Team — quick internal note summarizing where I landed after reviewing Kimberly's options and legal asks:

- Operational feasibility: Option A is doable if SRE schedule is firm (we can reserve 40 hours in July + 20 in August as contingency). Marissa: can you lock those slots if we agree to Option A?
- Financial exposure: cap rollback refund at 50% of the migration credit ($112,500) with a precise SLA trigger (p50 latency crossing target on two consecutive weekly windows of a 7-day assessment). That matches procurement's ask while keeping risk bounded.
- Legal / indemnity: push model-regression items to support remediation (SRE priority & engineering diagnostics) and explicitly exclude third-party model data quality claims from commercial refunds. We should offer a 180-day support escalation path instead.
- Next steps: Kimberly to prepare a DocuSign packet with Option A + the capped rollback language + legal redline (redwood_terms_redline.docx). Marissa to confirm SRE availability and Connor to approve final numbers.

If we sign by June 20 we can meet the implementation window to front-load onboarding in July.

Connor O'Brien
Manager, Strategic Deals | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.ai | +1 650 555 0123
